title: Chaos & Disrepair
description:
Abnormalities can cause broad effects to your facility. They are categorized under the following terms.

- Chaos: General abnormality instability. When something causes a unit of chaos, a random containment unit's counter increases.

- Disrepair: Malfunctioning of containment units. Some abnormalities mess with containment units, either physically or otherwise. This causes the units to require maintenance.

Make careful note of which abnormalities cause Chaos and Disrepair. Tool abnormalities are especially dangerous due to how commonly they do this.
